_note: Picture modes exposed by the XL2540 over DDC/CI are 4, 5, 8 and 11 (0x04, 0x05, 0x08, 0x0B). Which number maps to which on-screen mode is not documented, so run 'benq-display.ps1 -Identify' and note the one that looks like night. brightness/contrast are 0-100; mode may be null to leave the monitor's current picture mode alone.
